caption: Traffic lights change from red to green above a wet street at night, and their reflections on the road change colour at the same moment.

sa.check: Traffic lights hang above a street.
They change from red to green.
Their reflections on the road change colour at the same moment.
The street is wet and it is night.
The order is red first, green after.

pc.expect: The coloured streaks on the wet road switch colour when the lights do, at the same moment.
pc.fail: The streaks stay red after the light is green; or they change before the light; or they show a colour the lights never show.

pc.expect: The streaks match the lights' colours and lie below them.
pc.fail: They are a different colour from the lights; or they lie above the lights; or they are the wrong number.

pc.expect: The streaks do not move on their own.
pc.fail: They drift across the road; or flicker with steady lights; or shift sideways.

pc.expect: The road is wet: the streaks shimmer where puddles ripple and are absent where the road is dry.
pc.fail: They are sharp mirror images on rough tarmac; or they appear on dry patches; or the water is rigid.

pc.expect: The lights keep their number and stay on their pole.
pc.fail: A light vanishes or appears; or the pole moves; or a streak becomes solid.

pc.expect: The pole, the street and the buildings stay the same.
pc.fail: The pole changes; or the buildings rearrange; or the road markings shift.
